segment: 跨卷专题 · 熟词僻义与主题词

entries.quote: Boston Globe reporter Chris Reidy notes that the situation will improve only when there are comprehensive programs that address the many needs of the homeless.
entries.quote_zh: 《波士顿环球报》记者克里斯·里迪指出，只有出现能应对无家可归者诸多需求的综合性项目，状况才会改善。
entries.meaning: 处理、应对（问题、需求、担忧）
entries.note: address + 抽象名词（needs / misuse / worry）是考研高频动词化僻义，写作中比 deal with 更正式；三卷复现（2006 完形、2016 Text 1、2018 Text 3）。
entries.common_meaning: n. 地址；v. 向……讲话、发表演说
entries.rare_meaning: v. 处理、应对、设法解决（抽象问题）

entries.quote: His argument is that the unusual history of these people has subjected them to unique evolutionary pressures that have resulted in this paradoxical state of affairs.
entries.quote_zh: 他的论点是，这群人不同寻常的历史使他们承受了独特的进化压力，从而造就了这一看似矛盾的状况。
entries.meaning: 使遭受；受制于、须经
entries.note: subject sb to sth（使…经受）、be subject to（受…约束/须经）；2008 完形考 subjected them to pressures，2012 完形考 make itself subject to the code。
entries.common_meaning: n. 主题、学科、主语
entries.rare_meaning: v. 使遭受、使经受；adj. 受制于、须经（subject to）

entries.quote: the safety net offered by unemployment insurance or disability insurance to help families weather bad times.
entries.quote_zh: 由失业保险或伤残保险提供的安全网，帮助家庭渡过艰难时期。
entries.meaning: （动词）安全渡过、挺过（难关）
entries.note: weather bad times / weather the storm 为固定搭配；名词「天气」转动词「经受住风雨」，是典型名动转用僻义。
entries.common_meaning: n. 天气、气象
entries.rare_meaning: v. 安全渡过、挺过（困难时期）

entries.quote: these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak
entries.quote_zh: 这些生物通过猎杀体弱者来维持猎物种群的健康
entries.meaning: 猎物、野味；（引申）本领、行当
entries.note: 2010 英一翻译 preserve the health of game 考「猎物」；2020 英二 Text 2 CEOs ... upped their game 考「提升本领/表现」。相隔十年两卷复现，义项落差极大。
entries.common_meaning: n. 游戏、比赛、一局
entries.rare_meaning: n. 猎物、野味（集合名词）；引申（one's game）本领、行当

entries.quote: But the cult of the authentic and the personal, "doing our own thing," has spelt the death of formal speech, writing, poetry and music.
entries.quote_zh: 然而，对「真实」与「个性」的推崇，即「各行其是」，已经宣告了正式演讲、写作、诗歌和音乐的消亡。
entries.meaning: 招致、意味着（不祥后果）
entries.note: spelt the death of formal speech 中 spell = 带来…的结局，不是「拼写」也不是「一段时期」；spell disaster / spell the end of 可迁移写作。
entries.common_meaning: v. 拼写；n. 咒语、一段时间
entries.rare_meaning: v. 招致、意味着（坏结果），spell the death of 招致…的消亡

entries.quote: Lots of Americans bought that nonsense, and over three decades, some 10 million smokers went to early graves.
entries.quote_zh: 许多美国人信了那套胡言，结果三十多年间约有一千万烟民早早进了坟墓。
entries.meaning: 相信、买账（某说法）；被收买
entries.note: 2005 英一 Text 2 bought that nonsense = 相信了那套胡说；2017 英一 Text 4 connections can be bought = 关系能被收买。及物动词后接抽象对象是判断僻义的信号。
entries.common_meaning: v. 购买、买
entries.rare_meaning: v. 相信、接受（说法/借口）；（被动 be bought）被收买、被买通

entries.quote: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections.
entries.quote_zh: 新的颠覆性技术有时会要求对宪法的保护条款作出崭新的适用。
entries.meaning: 新颖的、崭新的（形容词）
entries.note: novel applications of the Constitution's protections：novel 修饰「应用」，绝不能读成「小说」；比 new 更强调别开生面。
entries.common_meaning: n. 小说
entries.rare_meaning: adj. 新颖的、全新的、前所未有的

entries.quote: Part of the problem is that the justices are not bound by an ethics code.
entries.quote_zh: 问题的部分症结在于，大法官们并不受伦理准则的约束。
entries.meaning: 准则、法典、行为规范
entries.note: 2012 完形 ethics code（伦理准则）、2019 Text 3 voluntary code for the ethical use of AI（AI 伦理自愿规范）；法律/治理语境一律不作「密码」解。
entries.common_meaning: n. 密码、编码、邮政编码
entries.rare_meaning: n. 行为准则、法典、规范（ethics code / voluntary code）

entries.quote: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
entries.quote_zh: 虚荣心是恒常不变的；只有当人们负担不起'不这样做'时，才会开始更可持续地消费。
entries.meaning: 恒量、恒定不变的事物（名词）
entries.note: Vanity is a constant 中 constant 作名词表语，意为「恒常不变的东西」；形容词转名词是考研常见僻义路径。
entries.common_meaning: adj. 持续不断的、恒定的
entries.rare_meaning: n. 恒量、恒定不变的事物

entries.quote: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
entries.quote_zh: 此处所呈现的'社会疗法'最显眼的缺陷，是它并不能长久奏效。
entries.meaning: （社会问题的）对策、解决办法
entries.note: 2012 Text 1 the social cure 指「靠同辈压力改造社会的整套方案」，2013 Text 3 cure all the ills of humanity 用其动词「消除」义；由治病引申为治社会痼疾。
entries.common_meaning: v. 治愈（疾病）；n. 药物、疗法
entries.rare_meaning: n.（社会问题的）对策、解决办法（the social cure）

entries.quote: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.
entries.quote_zh: 浪费的时间是美国人经济与私人生活的累赘，更别提还令人恼火。
entries.meaning: 累赘、阻碍（a drag on + 抽象名词）
entries.note: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives：a drag on 后接「生活/增长/效率」等抽象名词，写作可替换 burden / hindrance。
entries.common_meaning: v. 拖、拽
entries.rare_meaning: n. 阻碍、负担、累赘（a drag on）

entries.quote: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
entries.quote_zh: 亚利桑那州曾试图制定与现行联邦政策并行的本州政策。
entries.meaning: （动词）制定、塑造、构建
entries.note: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies：fashion 与 policies 搭配只能是「制定/塑造」；注意与 in a ... fashion（以…方式）区分。
entries.common_meaning: n. 时尚、时装、方式
entries.rare_meaning: v.（精心）制定、塑造、做成（政策/制度）

entries.quote: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
entries.quote_zh: 但几乎没有哪个地方，委托人会比在美国更有理由抱怨。
entries.meaning: 理由、依据（常用复数 grounds）
entries.note: grounds for complaint（抱怨的理由）、on the grounds that（以…为理由/因为）为高频法政搭配；单数 ground 表「地面」，复数才表「依据」。
entries.common_meaning: n. 地面、土地；场地
entries.rare_meaning: n.（复数 grounds）理由、根据、依据（grounds for / on the grounds that）

entries.quote: Since students and parents expect a college degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible—or at least appear to be.
entries.quote_zh: 既然学生和家长指望大学文凭带来工作，培养出尽可能合格的毕业生——或至少看起来合格——就符合学校的最大利益。
entries.meaning: 利益、利害关系；（金融）利息
entries.note: in the best interest of（符合…的最大利益）、economic self-interest（经济私利）、interest rates（利率，2010 英二 Text 1）三处义项各异，均非「兴趣」。
entries.common_meaning: n. 兴趣、趣味；关注
entries.rare_meaning: n. 利益、利害关系；利息（interest rates）

entries.quote: The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
entries.quote_zh: 白宫辩称，即便州法不折不扣地符合联邦法规，亚利桑那州的法律仍与其执法优先次序相冲突。
entries.meaning: 字面意义（to the letter 不折不扣地）
entries.note: complied with federal statutes to the letter = 逐字逐条严格遵从联邦法规；the letter of the law（条文字面）与 the spirit（立法精神）对举。
entries.common_meaning: n. 信、函；字母
entries.rare_meaning: n. 字面意义（to the letter 严格照字面/不折不扣）

entries.quote: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
entries.quote_zh: 即便如此，这些仍是与国际顶层 1% 阶层往来酬酢的富裕家族，而媒体的无孔不入使其越来越难维持得体形象。
entries.meaning: （法律/交易）一方、当事人；参加交际
entries.note: a third party would pay（2010 英一 Text 4）中 party = 交易第三方；2015 英一 Text 1 party with the international 1% 则是动词「与…交际」。两卷义项不同，均为僻义。
entries.common_meaning: n. 聚会；政党
entries.rare_meaning: n.（法律/交易）一方、当事人；v. 参加社交聚会、与…交际

entries.quote: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
entries.quote_zh: 当企业把 CEO 薪酬与股价等挂钩时，股市反应积极——这表明此类做法提升的是整个公司的价值，而不只是 CEO 的。
entries.meaning: 惯例、惯常做法、通行操作方式
entries.note: the use of this little-known practice（2019 英一 Text 2 成绩宽恕）、This practice does not address...（2018 英一 Text 3）、those practices build up corporate value（本句）：三卷均指制度性做法，非「练习」。
entries.common_meaning: n. 练习、实践；v. 练习
entries.rare_meaning: n. 惯例、惯常做法、（机构通行的）操作方式

entries.quote: Instead of a plan of action, they continue to press for more research -- a classic case of "paralysis by analysis."
entries.quote_zh: 他们拿不出行动计划，反而不断要求更多研究——这是「分析致瘫」的典型案例。
entries.meaning: 敦促、强烈要求；新闻界、报界
entries.note: press for more research = 一再要求更多研究；be published in the daily press（2010 英一 Text 1）= 刊于日报/新闻界。动词与名词两处僻义分属不同卷。
entries.common_meaning: v. 按、压、挤；n. 按压
entries.rare_meaning: v. 敦促、极力要求（press for）；n. 新闻界、报界（the press）

entries.quote: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
entries.quote_zh: 但如今除许多选拔性强的院校外，多数高校允许所有本科生、甚至研究生把低分「宽恕」掉。
entries.meaning: （介词）除……之外，等于 except for
entries.note: save for many selective campuses = 除少数择优录取的院校之外；save (for) 作介词是正式书面用法，考生极易误读为动词「拯救」。
entries.common_meaning: v. 拯救、节省、储蓄
entries.rare_meaning: prep. 除…之外，等于 except for

entries.quote: “What millions of Texas kids learn in their public schools is determined too often by the political ideology of partisan board members, rather than facts and sound scholarship.”
entries.quote_zh: 「数百万得州孩子在公立学校学到什么，往往由党派倾向的委员的政治意识形态决定，而非事实与严谨的学术。」
entries.meaning: （形容词）扎实可靠的、健全的、严谨的
entries.note: facts and sound scholarship 中 sound 修饰 scholarship，意为「扎实严谨的学术」；a sound policy / sound judgment 同类，写作可替换 reliable / rigorous。
entries.common_meaning: n. 声音；v. 听起来（系动词）
entries.rare_meaning: adj. 扎实可靠的、健全的、无懈可击的

entries.quote: Old objects continue to deteriorate. Worse, biodegradable plastics, designed to disintegrate, are increasingly common. And more is at stake here than individual objects.
entries.quote_zh: 旧物件持续劣化；更糟的是，为易于降解而设计的可生物降解塑料日益普遍。而这里利害攸关的还不只是单件物品。
entries.meaning: 利害关系、成败所系（at stake）
entries.note: more is at stake here than individual objects = 利害所关远不止单件物品；at stake / have a stake in / stakeholder 为一族高频搭配。
entries.common_meaning: n. 桩、柱；赌注
entries.rare_meaning: n. 利害关系、风险（at stake 利害攸关）

entries.quote: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
entries.quote_zh: 消费者如今作出购买决策的方式意味着，营销的影响力源自传统付费媒体之外的一系列广泛因素。
entries.meaning: 源于、起因于（stem from）
entries.note: marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors：stem from 表因果溯源，写作可替换 derive from / arise from；注意与 stem the flow（遏制）反义。
entries.common_meaning: n. 茎、干；v. 堵住、遏制
entries.rare_meaning: v. 起源于、由…造成（stem from）

entries.quote: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
entries.quote_zh: 在许多方面，道德宗旨的缺失不仅框定了如此普遍的电话窃听这一事实，也框定了审判得以展开的条件。
entries.meaning: （复数 terms）条款、条件
entries.note: the terms on which the trial took place = 审判得以展开的条件/条款；terms of an agreement、come to terms 义项各异，法政语境优先取「条款」。
entries.common_meaning: n. 学期；术语；期限
entries.rare_meaning: n.（复数）条款、条件、（协议/审判赖以进行的）条件

entries.quote: These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
entries.quote_zh: 这些准则要求银行按第三方愿意支付的价格为某些资产估值，而非管理层和监管者希望它们能卖出的价格。
entries.meaning: （动词）为…估值、给…定价
entries.note: value some assets at the price a third party would pay：银行会计语境里 value 是「估值」而非「重视」；value sth at + 价格 是固定搭配。
entries.common_meaning: n. 价值、价值观；v. 重视、珍视
entries.rare_meaning: v. 给…估价、按某价格估值（value assets at ...）

entries.quote: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
entries.quote_zh: 最高法院如今将审议：逮捕时若手机在嫌疑人身上或近旁，警方能否在无搜查令的情况下查看手机内容。
entries.meaning: （名词）令状、搜查令
entries.note: search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant：2015 英一 Text 2 考数字时代搜查令，warrant 为法律术语，不是「保证/使有必要」。
entries.common_meaning: v. 使有必要、值得；n. 保证、正当理由
entries.rare_meaning: n.（法院/法官签发的）令状、搜查令

entries.quote: That matters because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels.
entries.quote_zh: 这一点很重要，因为理论表明，一个渔场可捕取的最大可持续产量，出现在目标物种生物量约为其原始水平 50% 之时。
entries.meaning: 产出、产量（名词）
entries.note: the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery：2006 英一 Text 3 渔业语境，yield 作名词表「产量」，与「屈服」落差极大。
entries.common_meaning: v. 屈服、让步；产生（结果）
entries.rare_meaning: n. 产出、产量（maximum sustainable yield）

entries.quote: Feelings of righteous indignation, it seems, are not the preserve of people alone.
entries.quote_zh: 看来，义愤之情并非人类所独有。
entries.meaning: 专属领域、独有之物（the preserve of）
entries.note: are not the preserve of people alone（2005 英一 Text 1）、the preserve of the super-rich（2021 英一 Text 3）两处均指「专属/专利」；注意 the + preserve + of 结构。
entries.common_meaning: v. 保护、保存、腌制；n. 果酱
entries.rare_meaning: n.（the preserve of）某群体的专属领域、独享之物

entries.quote: These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press.
entries.quote_zh: 这些人把新闻业视为一种天职，并以能在日报上发表文章为荣。
entries.meaning: 天职、使命感（视为使命的职业）
entries.note: believed in journalism as a calling = 把新闻业当作天职；与 vocation 近义，写作可表达职业认同。
entries.common_meaning: call 的现在分词/动名词：呼叫、打电话
entries.rare_meaning: n. 天职、使命感、神召

entries.quote: at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared.
entries.quote_zh: 那时新闻纸便宜得要命，而格调高雅的艺术评论被视为其所刊载刊物的点缀。
entries.meaning: n. 装饰品；（抽象）增色之物、点缀、门面
entries.note: stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications：不是具体摆件，而是「为刊物增色的点缀」；由具体装饰引申为抽象增色。

entries.quote: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday—a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
entries.quote_zh: 最高法院周一以五比三的票数推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分条款——这是奥巴马政府一次不算大的政策胜利。
entries.meaning: n. 法院、法庭（司法机构）；v. 谋求、招致（court criticism）
entries.note: 法政类阅读中 court 几乎总指法院 / 法庭；作动词时表「谋求、招致」，如 court controversy，是写作可用的中性表达。

entries.quote: All but two pieces sold, fetching more than £70m, a record for a sale by a single artist.
entries.quote_zh: 除两件外全部售出，成交价逾七千万英镑，创下单一艺术家专场拍卖的纪录。
entries.meaning: 售得、卖到（某价格）
entries.note: fetching more than £70m（2010 英二 Text 1 拍卖）、the price ... would like them to fetch（2010 英一 Text 4 资产估值）：同年两卷同考「售得」，是跨卷复现的典型。
entries.common_meaning: v. 去取来、拿来；接（人）
entries.rare_meaning: v. 售得、卖到（某价格）

entries.quote: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated.
entries.quote_zh: 一名法官现已推翻该市停止征收罚金的决定，并下令恢复征收。
entries.meaning: 罚款、罚金（名词）
entries.note: stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated（2020 英二 Text 3 清洁空气区）：fine 与 levy（征收）搭配只能是「罚金」，与「好的/细微的」毫无关系。
entries.common_meaning: adj. 好的、精美的、细微的；adv. 很好地
entries.rare_meaning: n. 罚款、罚金（levy fines / pay a fine）

entries.quote: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market.
entries.quote_zh: 比尔斯基案涉及一项声称的专利，即一种在能源市场对冲风险的方法。
entries.meaning: 对冲（风险）、套期保值
entries.note: a method for hedging risk in the energy market（2010 英一 Text 2 Bilski 案）：金融法律语境的专门义，hedge against inflation 可迁移。
entries.common_meaning: n. 树篱、篱笆；v. 回避正面回答
entries.rare_meaning: v. 对冲（金融风险）、套期保值

entries.quote: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal.
entries.quote_zh: 论文内容既然免费到手，出版商只需为期刊找到市场即可。
entries.meaning: （经努力）获得、争取到
entries.note: With the content of papers secured for free：secure 后接具体资源表「弄到手」，写作可替换 obtain / gain；勿读作「使安全」。
entries.common_meaning: adj. 安全的、稳妥的；v. 保卫
entries.rare_meaning: v.（经努力）获得、确保取得（资源/资金）

entries.quote: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
entries.quote_zh: 相反，数字服务税是一个更大趋势的一部分：过去几年各国纷纷提出或实施一大堆以字母缩写命名的国际税收新条款。
entries.meaning: （法律文件的）条款、规定（复数）
entries.note: contested provisions of Arizona's plan（2013 英一 Text 4）、new international tax provisions（2020 英一 Text 4）两处均指法条条款；与「食品储备」义落差大。
entries.common_meaning: n. 供应、准备；（复数）食品储备
entries.rare_meaning: n.（法律、协议的）条款、规定

entries.quote: Americans no longer expect public figures, whether in speech or in writing, to command the English language with skill and gift.
entries.quote_zh: 美国人已不再期待公众人物无论演讲还是写作，都能娴熟而富有天赋地运用英语。
entries.meaning: 娴熟掌握、运用自如（语言/技艺）
entries.note: command the English language with skill and gift（2005 英一 Text 4）：command + 语言/技能 = 驾驭自如，不是「命令语言」。
entries.common_meaning: v./n. 命令、指挥、控制
entries.rare_meaning: v. 娴熟掌握、运用自如；博得（尊重）

entries.quote: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
entries.quote_zh: 在许多方面，道德宗旨的缺失不仅框定了如此普遍的电话窃听这一事实，也框定了审判得以展开的条件。
entries.meaning: 框定、界定（范围、叙事）；构陷
entries.note: frames not only the fact ... but the terms on which the trial took place：frame 作动词表「框定/界定」；新闻语境还可表「诬陷」（be framed）。
entries.common_meaning: n. 框架、相框、骨架
entries.rare_meaning: v. 界定、框定；构陷、诬陷

entries.quote: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
entries.quote_zh: 但在更为重要的宪法问题上，这一判决以八比零挫败了政府试图打破联邦与州之间权力平衡的努力。
entries.meaning: 打乱、颠覆（权力平衡、秩序）
entries.note: upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states（2013 英一 Text 4）：宾语是抽象「平衡」，义为「颠覆」，非「使难过」。
entries.common_meaning: adj. 心烦的；v. 使难过、使不适
entries.rare_meaning: v. 打乱、颠覆、推翻（平衡、假定、秩序）

entries.quote: “Short-termism,” or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane.
entries.quote_zh: 英格兰银行首席经济学家安德鲁·霍尔丹说，「短期主义」、即对快速获利的渴求，在上市公司中已愈发严重。
entries.meaning: 短期主义（追逐快利而牺牲长远）
entries.note: 2019 英一 Text 1：or the desire for quick profits 是同位释义；写作可与 long-term investment 对举。

entries.quote: That timing could reward high-quality service and give workers an incentive to provide it.
entries.quote_zh: 这一时机既能奖励优质服务，也能给服务人员提供继续提供优质服务的激励。
entries.meaning: 激励、动机、刺激（机制）
entries.note: give workers an incentive to provide it（2025 英二 Text 1）、provide incentives for executives（2019 英一 Text 1）、had the power and incentive to favor...（2021 英一 Text 4）：三卷复现，incentive to do / incentives for sb 为高频搭配。

entries.quote: The prevalence of digital payment devices has made it easier to ask customers for a tip.
entries.quote_zh: 数字支付设备的普及，使得向顾客索要小费变得更容易。
entries.meaning: 普及、盛行、普遍存在
entries.note: The prevalence of digital payment devices（2025 英二 Text 1）：prevalence 是 pervasive（无处不在的）的名词形式，the prevalence of X has made it easier to... 可迁移写作。

entries.quote: The court cannot maintain its legitimacy as guardian of the rule of law when justices behave like politicians.
entries.quote_zh: 当大法官们表现得像政客时，最高法院便无法维系其作为法治守护者的合法性。
entries.meaning: 合法性、正当性（制度被认可的程度）
entries.note: maintain its legitimacy as guardian of the rule of law（2012 英一 完形）、the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users（2020 英一 Text 2）：两卷均指制度的正当性，非 legal（合法）本身。

entries.quote: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
entries.quote_zh: 根本上，美国邮政陷入历史性挤压：一边是技术变革永久压低了对其拳头产品——一类邮件——的需求，一边是监管架构剥夺了管理层按新现实调整经营的灵活性。
entries.meaning: 监管的、管制的（regulatory structure）
entries.note: a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility（2018 英一 Text 4 USPS）：写作可用 regulatory framework / regulatory burden 讨论政府与市场边界。

entries.quote: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment—including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line—Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
entries.quote_zh: 尽管数家快时尚公司已努力遏制其对劳工与环境的影响——包括 H&M 推出绿色'自觉系列'——Cline 认为，持久的改变唯有由消费者来促成。
entries.meaning: 抑制、遏制、约束
entries.note: made efforts to curb their impact（2013 英一 Text 1）、to curb the tech giants（2018 英一 Text 3）：curb + 抽象对象（影响/巨头/排放）是环境、治理议题高频动词。

entries.quote: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
entries.quote_zh: 这是同辈压力的一种微妙形式：我们会无意识地模仿每天所见的行为。
entries.meaning: 同辈压力、朋辈压力
entries.note: a subtle form of peer pressure（2012 英一 Text 1）：与 the social cure 同篇，指群体无意识模仿；注意与 peer review（同行评议）区分。

entries.quote: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.
entries.quote_zh: 一项关于各国把增长转化为福祉之能力的最新年度研究，为这一问题提供了一些线索。
entries.meaning: 福祉、幸福感、安康
entries.note: convert growth into well-being（2017 英一 Text 3）：把增长转化为国民福祉，是「增长之外」议题的核心术语。

entries.quote: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically contentious, and therefore vulnerable.
entries.quote_zh: 在诸多弱点中，城市独自应对空气污染时不得不采取的措施在政治上易受争议，因而十分脆弱、易被推翻。
entries.meaning: 脆弱的、易受伤害/易被推翻的
entries.note: politically contentious, and therefore vulnerable（2020 英二 Text 3）：指地方治污措施因政治争议而「易被废除」；be vulnerable to + 风险 为高频搭配。

entries.quote: It is not enough to say that the algorithms DeepMind develops will benefit patients and save lives.
entries.quote_zh: 仅仅说 DeepMind 开发的算法将造福患者、挽救生命，是不够的。
entries.meaning: 算法；（引申）平台自动化决策规则
entries.note: the algorithms DeepMind develops（2018 英一 Text 3）：AI 治理议题核心词，常与 transparency / accountability 共现。

entries.quote: That misses the way the surveillance economy works. The data of an individual there gains its value only when it is compared with the data of countless millions more.
entries.quote_zh: 这没有看清「监控经济」的运作方式：在那里，个体数据只有与千百万人的数据比对时才产生价值。
entries.meaning: 监控、监视（surveillance economy 监控经济）
entries.note: That misses the way the surveillance economy works（2018 英一 Text 3）：由「监视」构成复合术语，讨论数据价值与隐私。

entries.quote: The current emphasis on standardized testing highlights analysis and procedure, meaning that few of us inherently use our innovative and collaborative modes of thought.
entries.quote_zh: 当下对标准化考试的强调凸显了分析与程序，意味着我们中很少有人会本能地运用创新与协作的思维模式。
entries.meaning: 标准化考试（统一命题、统一评分）
entries.note: The current emphasis on standardized testing highlights analysis and procedure（2009 英一 Text 1）：与 innovative and collaborative modes of thought 对举，教育改革议题常考。

entries.quote: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance.
entries.quote_zh: 正如无数董事会和企业主会证实的那样，限制企业解雇表现不佳的高薪经理，无异于给提升生产率和整体绩效踩了手刹。
entries.meaning: 劳动生产率、生产率
entries.note: automotive-assembly productivity（2009 英一 Text 3）、a handbrake on boosting productivity（本句，2022 英一 Text 4）：两卷复现，常见搭配 boost / constrain productivity。

entries.quote: Their methods do not attempt to estimate the actual biomass (the amount of living biological matter) of fish species in particular parts of the ocean, but rather changes in that biomass over time.
entries.quote_zh: 他们的方法并不试图估算特定海域鱼类物种的实际生物量，而是估算该生物量随时间发生的变化。
entries.meaning: （某区域/物种的）生物量
entries.note: estimate the actual biomass of fish species（2006 英一 Text 3）：渔业可持续产量语境的专业术语，与 maximum sustainable yield 同篇。

entries.quote: These would emphasise the primacy of human activity in recent climate change and encourage discussion of mitigation measures.
entries.quote_zh: 这些标准将强调人类活动在近期气候变化中的首要作用，并鼓励讨论减缓措施。
entries.meaning: 减缓、缓解（措施），（气候）减缓
entries.note: encourage discussion of mitigation measures（2023 英一 Text 1 气候教材标准争议）：与 adaptation（适应）并列为气候政策两大术语。

entries.quote: Now, consider three indices of assimilation -- language, home ownership and intermarriage.
entries.quote_zh: 现在来看同化的三项指标——语言、住房自有率和异族通婚。
entries.meaning: （移民的）同化、融入主流社会
entries.note: three indices of assimilation -- language, home ownership and intermarriage（2006 英一 Text 1）：以三项指标量化同化程度；与 homogenize（趋同）同源。

entries.quote: Writing for the National Immigration Forum, Gregory Rodriguez reports that today's immigration is neither at unprecedented levels nor resistant to assimilation.
entries.quote_zh: 格雷戈里·罗德里格斯在为国家移民论坛撰文时指出，当今的移民既未达到空前规模，也并不抗拒同化。
entries.meaning: 空前的、前所未有的
entries.note: neither at unprecedented levels nor resistant to assimilation（2006 英一 Text 1）：unprecedented + 规模/速度/挑战 是高阶强调，语气强于 new。

entries.quote: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
entries.quote_zh: 对某产品满怀热情的消费者可能通过自愿向朋友推荐而创造'赢得型'媒体，企业则可借向网站注册用户发送产品与促销邮件提醒来运营'自有型'媒体。
entries.meaning: 赢得型媒体（消费者自发推荐形成的口碑传播）
entries.note: create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends（2011 英一 Text 3）：与 owned / paid media 对举，营销传播术语。

entries.quote: Yet as distrust has risen toward all media, people may be starting to beef up their media literacy skills. Such a trend is badly needed.
entries.quote_zh: 然而随着对所有媒体的不信任上升，人们或许正开始增强自身的媒介素养技能；这种趋势亟需。
entries.meaning: 媒介素养（辨别、评估媒体信息的能力）
entries.note: beef up their media literacy skills（2018 英一 Text 2）：在「对媒体不信任上升」语境中提出，与 misinformation 议题相关。

entries.quote: the limbic system (the "emotional brain") is especially active, while the prefrontal cortex (the center of intellect and reasoning) is relatively quiet.
entries.quote_zh: 边缘系统（「情绪脑」）格外活跃，而前额叶皮层（智力与推理的中枢）则相对安静。
entries.meaning: 边缘系统（大脑主管情绪的区域）
entries.note: the limbic system (the "emotional brain") is especially active（2005 英一 Text 3）：与 prefrontal cortex（理智中枢）对举，解释情绪决策。

entries.quote: Researchers measured people's cortisol, which is a stress marker, while they were at work and while they were at home and found it higher at what is supposed to be a place of refuge.
entries.quote_zh: 研究人员测量了人们的皮质醇（一种压力标记物），分别在上班时与在家时测量，结果发现，在本应是避风港的家里，其水平反而更高。
entries.meaning: 皮质醇（压力激素，用作压力标记物）
entries.note: measured people's cortisol, which is a stress marker（2015 英二 Text 1）：以生理指标量化「在家压力大于上班」，是实证研究类文章常见术语。

entries.quote: All this could change the traditional form of the peer-review process, at least for the publication of papers.
entries.quote_zh: 这一切都可能改变同行评议的传统形式，至少在论文发表环节如此。
entries.meaning: 同行评议/同行评审（成果发表前的专家评审）
entries.note: change the traditional form of the peer-review process（2008 英一 Text 2）、adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process（2015 英一 Text 3）：两卷复现，学术可信度议题核心。

entries.quote: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
entries.quote_zh: 但要让一项发现声明蜕变为成熟发现，需要集体审查与认可。
entries.meaning: （集体/公众的）仔细审查、监督
entries.note: it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery（2012 英一 Text 3）：与 credibility process 同篇，scrutiny 强调「经得起细查」。

entries.quote: we may consider the original Puritans as carriers of European culture
entries.quote_zh: 我们不妨把最初的清教徒视作欧洲文化的承载者
entries.meaning: 清教徒（的）；十七世纪新英格兰移民的宗教文化传统
entries.note: the original Puritans as carriers of European culture（2009 英一 Text 4）：美国早期文化史议题的专有名词。

entries.quote: In spite of "endless talk of difference," American society is an amazing machine for homogenizing people.
entries.quote_zh: 尽管人们没完没了地谈论差异，美国社会却是一台同化人们的神奇机器。
entries.meaning: 使趋同、使同质化、同化
entries.note: American society is an amazing machine for homogenizing people（2006 英一 Text 1）：与 assimilation 同篇，动词强调「抹平差异」的机制。

entries.quote: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
entries.quote_zh: 随着董事会迫于股东压力仔细审视继任计划，未获首肯的高管也可能萌生去意。
entries.meaning: （高管）继任计划
entries.note: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure（2011 英一 Text 2）：公司治理与高管更替议题术语。

entries.quote: By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s.
entries.quote_zh: 从多数指标看，自 20 世纪 70 年代以来，公司治理已变得严密、严谨得多。
entries.meaning: 公司治理（对管理层与股东的制度约束）
entries.note: corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s（2020 英二 Text 2 CEO 薪酬）：与 CEO pay / regulatory 同篇，是解释高管薪酬的制度背景词。
